environment.description: FastAPI service deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer. The ECS task role IAM policy includes a condition block with dynamodb:LeadingKeys set to ${aws:PrincipalTag/tenant_id} which is populated per-request via STS session tags propagated from the Cognito identity pool's role mapping. Additionally, the ALB has a listener rule that evaluates the `Origin` header via a custom Lambda@Edge authorizer attached to the CloudFront distribution sitting in front of the ALB — this authorizer returns 403 for any WebSocket upgrade request where the Origin header does not match the registered domain allowlist stored in a Parameter Store SecureString (/prod/allowed-origins). The CloudFront distribution has a custom origin request policy that strips and re-signs the connection upgrade only when the Lambda@Edge function returns a 200 with a signed nonce header (X-WS-Nonce) that the ALB validates via a header-based routing rule before forwarding to the target group.

config.cloudfront_lambda_edge: viewer-request trigger validates Origin header against /prod/allowed-origins parameter, returns 403 if mismatch
config.cloudfront_origin_request_policy: strips upgrade headers unless Lambda@Edge injects X-WS-Nonce signed with KMS key alias/ws-auth
config.alb_listener_rule: routes to target group only if X-WS-Nonce header present and matches HMAC pattern; otherwise returns fixed 403
config.cognito_identity_pool: authenticated role mapping sets aws:PrincipalTag/tenant_id from Cognito sub claim via STS AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
config.parameter_store: /prod/allowed-origins contains JSON allowlist of valid origins
